title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
abstract: arXiv:2609.08183v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires a concrete mechanism through which an AI system observes its capabilities and converts that evidence into the next round of learning. We present NeoHorse-1, a family of agent-native models developed to explore this path through agentic post-training. Our system combines a heterogeneous model pool with intelligent routing, recording the predicted capability demand, selected service tier, and subsequent interaction for each user turn. These records are converted into training examples that preserve interleaved reasoning, tool calls, and harness context, and are admitted through structural validation, six-dimensional semantic evaluation, and subscene-level labeling. Routing signals organize supervised fine-tuning into a three-stage curriculum and extend to routing-guided on-policy distillation, where a teacher supervises student-generated responses under the same progression. translated_title: NeoHorse-1：通过路由线束的智能体后训练迈向递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）需要一个具体的机制，使AI系统能够观察自身的能力，并将这些证据转化为下一轮学习。我们提出了NeoHorse-1，这是一系列智能体原生模型，旨在通过智能体后训练探索这条路径。我们的系统将异构模型池与智能路由相结合，为每个用户轮次记录预测的能力需求、所选服务层级以及后续交互。这些记录被转换为保留交错推理、工具调用和线束上下文的训练样本，并通过结构验证、六维语义评估和子场景级标注进行准入筛选。路由信号将监督微调组织为三阶段课程，并进一步扩展到路由引导的在策略蒸馏，其中教师模型在相同的进阶过程中监督学生模型生成的响应。能力引导的……（摘要不完整，后续内容缺失）
tldr: NeoHorse-1提出了一种智能体后训练框架，通过智能路由记录模型交互并将其转化为经过多维验证的训练数据，再结合三阶段课程监督微调与路由引导的在策略蒸馏，向递归自我改进迈出了具体一步。
en_tdlr: NeoHorse-1 introduces an agentic post-training framework that converts routing-harness interaction records into validated training data, then applies a three-stage curriculum SFT with routing-guided on-policy distillation, taking a concrete step toward recursive self-improvement.
